{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()

print(f'Duplicate patient IDs: {duplicate_patients}')

# Check if all patient_ids are unique
are_unique = df['patient_id'].nunique() == len(df)
print(f'All patient_ids are unique: {are_unique}')"}
